title: Payments Fraud Risk Data Platform
summary: Governed local-first fraud-risk monitoring and capacity-aware analyst triage over a simulated source.
outcome: Retain the ordinary logistic baseline for the measured 1% review queue; reject the class-weighted challenger.

source.name: Sparkov simulated credit-card transactions
source.dataBoundary: Raw and event-level source data remains local. Public hosting contains two source-level aggregates and fixed evaluation evidence only.

limitations: One chronological holdout without confidence intervals
No live scoring or payment decision
No fairness analysis or threshold sweep
